about_the_game:
Playing Cards Book

This Playing Cards book unlocks a huge 54 additional levels for Coloring Pixels! An image for each card in a standard deck of playing cards, in the New Deck Order!

Get ready to shuffle and play with one of the most iconic decks in the world!

Contents
